Réparation (116) ← parentId: 103 Luna: → [005] Communication     — emits HEAL message, never calls directly

_views.text: Réparation is the healing module of Luna. It is invoked by the RÉPARATION ritual keyword. It emits a HEAL_ALL message on the bus. Every module that needs healing subscribes and applies its own reset. Nothing is deleted — Archive history is always preserved. The confirmation message '❤️ Le système se répare avec douceur' appears immediately. Réparation is the gentlest and most complete operation in the system.
